name: UniSQ Indigenous Student Success Program Scholarships
summary: Education costs and relocation scholarships for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander UniSQ students on low-to-middle incomes.
key: Each scholarship will have a maximum value of $4000 to be paid in one instalment.
who: Enrolled in at least one unit in the study period
how: Apply through the UniSQ Scholarship Application Management System
catches: Opens each trimester; the Trimester 3 2026 round closed 31 August 2026
